title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #14 (Term 2)

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #14 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why must we clean najasaat before prayer? (1 mark)
   A. It saves water
   B. Purity is a condition for valid prayer
   C. It is only for adults
   D. It is a game

2. Which of these is NOT a najasa? (1 mark)
   A. Human sweat
   B. Blood that flows
   C. Vomit
   D. Stool

3. What is mud on your clothes? (1 mark)
   A. A medium najasa
   B. Normal dirt, not a najasa
   C. A heavy najasa
   D. A light najasa

4. Kamal made wudhu at 6 a.m. and only ate lunch. Is wudhu still valid? (1 mark)
   A. Yes
   B. Only if he sleeps
   C. Only if he rinses
   D. No

5. Which of these is recommended before going to sleep? (1 mark)
   A. Skip prayer
   B. Shout
   C. Eat a big meal
   D. Make wudhu

6. If you are sure you made wudhu and only doubt that it broke, what should you assume? (1 mark)
   A. Your wudhu is broken
   B. You are still in wudhu
   C. You must never pray
   D. You are in ghusl

7. Which prayer begins at midday after the sun passes its highest point? (1 mark)
   A. Dhuhr
   B. Maghrib
   C. Fajr
   D. Isha

8. What is a difference between a condition and a pillar? (1 mark)
   A. They are the same
   B. A condition is inside prayer
   C. A condition is before the prayer, a pillar is inside it
   D. A pillar is before prayer

9. Which prayer has two rak'ahs? (1 mark)
   A. Maghrib
   B. Asr
   C. Dhuhr
   D. Fajr

10. Which is a pillar and not a condition? (1 mark)
   A. Wudhu
   B. Facing the Qibla
   C. Ruku
   D. Time of prayer

11. What should a person do if unable to stand for obligatory prayer because of illness? (1 mark)
   A. Wait until well
   B. Pray later in the year
   C. Skip the prayer
   D. Pray sitting

12. What is sujud? (1 mark)
   A. Bowing
   B. Greeting
   C. Prostration
   D. Standing

13. Why do animals give us benefit? (1 mark)
   A. They are useless
   B. They only eat
   C. They give us food, milk, work and transport
   D. They cannot help

14. Which is a safe practice around stray dogs? (1 mark)
   A. Chase them
   B. Feed them by hand
   C. Do not go near them and tell an adult
   D. Tease them

15. Which is a Kenyan Muslim garment for men? (1 mark)
   A. Sari
   B. Hijab
   C. Kanzu
   D. Buibui

16. What does haya mean? (1 mark)
   A. Modesty
   B. Anger
   C. Pride
   D. Speed

17. Which of these is print media? (1 mark)
   A. Television
   B. Radio
   C. Film
   D. Newspaper

18. What should come before screen time? (1 mark)
   A. Games
   B. Videos
   C. Nothing
   D. Prayer, homework and helping at home

19. Which is a good way to help someone who cannot work? (1 mark)
   A. Insult them
   B. Give zakah and sadaqah
   C. Ignore them
   D. Avoid them

20. What did the Prophet say about cutting and selling firewood? (1 mark)
   A. It is better than asking people
   B. It is only for the poor
   C. It is shameful
   D. It is forbidden

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Halima made wudhu for Fajr. Later she took a short nap sitting up and then passed wind. Is her wudhu valid? Explain. (4 marks)

22. Describe how to find the Qibla using the sun in Kenya. (3 marks)

23. Give three benefits of the Islamic dress code. (3 marks)

24. State three things that nullify wudhu. (3 marks)

25. State three groups of people who deserve help. (3 marks)

26. State two ways to know the times of prayer. (2 marks)

27. Give one example of each type of najasa. (3 marks)

28. How should a Muslim treat a person who asks for help? (4 marks)

29. What do we say in ruku, in sujud and when sitting between the two sujud? (3 marks)

30. Give two items used in purification of najasaat. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #14 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Purity is a condition for valid prayer
   Prayer is not valid with najasa on the body, clothes or place.

2. A — Human sweat
   Sweat is pure.

3. B — Normal dirt, not a najasa
   Mud is not najasa though we clean for neatness.

4. A — Yes
   Eating does not break wudhu.

5. D — Make wudhu
   The Prophet told Al-Bara ibn Azib to do this.

6. B — You are still in wudhu
   Doubt does not remove certainty.

7. A — Dhuhr
   Dhuhr begins after the sun passes noon.

8. C — A condition is before the prayer, a pillar is inside it
   Conditions before, pillars inside.

9. D — Fajr
   Fajr has two.

10. C — Ruku
   Ruku is inside the prayer.

11. D — Pray sitting
   Islam gives ease.

12. C — Prostration
   Forehead on the ground.

13. C — They give us food, milk, work and transport
   Animals serve people.

14. C — Do not go near them and tell an adult
   Some animals may bite.

15. C — Kanzu
   Kanzu is a long robe.

16. A — Modesty
   Haya is modesty or shyness from wrong.

17. D — Newspaper
   Print media is printed on paper.

18. D — Prayer, homework and helping at home
   Priorities first.

19. B — Give zakah and sadaqah
   Islam encourages charity.

20. A — It is better than asking people
   Recorded in Al-Bukhari.

SECTION B
----
21. (4 marks)
   Answer: Her nap sitting up did not break wudhu, but passing wind did. So her wudhu is broken and she must make it again.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the nap, 1 mark for wind, 1 mark for broken, 1 mark for making wudhu again.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stretch the right arm towards the sunrise, which is east, and face forward, which is roughly north. Confirm with a compass or mosque.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the right arm to east, 1 mark for facing north, 1 mark for checking.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: Protection, dignity and respect, trains modesty and self-control, obedience to Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each benefit.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Urine, stool or wind; deep sleep lying down; fainting.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: People in debt, people who lost property through disaster, and the destitute.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: Adhan, printed mosque timetable, prayer app, watching the sun.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: Light: urine of a baby boy on milk only; medium: urine, stool, blood or vomit; heavy: dog or pig saliva.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each example.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: With kindness and respect, without driving him away, help if in real need, give quietly, or make a kind reply and dua.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ruku: Subhana Rabbiyal Azim; sujud: Subhana Rabbiyal A'la; sitting: Rabbighfir li.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: Water, soil, soap, clean cloth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
